hypothesis: Adding an evidence-trained candidate to the retained-context tournament improves adaptation to unfamiliar causal combinations while recovering prior worlds. All observations and hypotheses remain inside the existing cumulative native learner.
algorithm: Keep CKAD21 retained native window hypotheses and exact conditional mixture. At public begin_context(novel=True), allocate total prior7/8 uniformly to frozen consecutive32-witness block hypotheses (final partial if>=8) and1/8 to an empty candidate using identical PublicCausalCells and paired-view/structure-selection rules. For each actual probe receipt compute each prequential joint S2,Y likelihood, normalize context weights, then train only the new candidate with that actual receipt. Global native episode statistics and append-only ledger continue as before. Old candidate weights/banks are not refitted within a context. Conditional S2 weights govern terminal forecasts/plans. New candidate hypotheses use observed targets only. Legacy novel=False behavior stays exact.
